name: ModelVariant826_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant826_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the camera holds on the slot and then swings round while the ambient light dims and a scrolling tint washes over the whole screen; a pulsing, spinning glow follows a model part and up to sixteen shards appear around the opposing slot, flare to their row's colour and fade, then the tint and glow fade while the light comes back); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, clears the shards and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the delay, 2 once the light has recovered and the last shard has faded, 1 once when spawning ends, 4 while shards spawn and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-843 and 940 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x20 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
